title: 114쪽 · 3x BTN Open — BB 3-Bet —> BTN 4-Bet — BB 5-Bet (All-in)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Here Snowie is choosing to 5-bet shove most of its range instead of calling 3 4-bet out of position. This validates all the “crazy stuff" Vanessa Selbst was doing back in the early 2000s. Google “Vanessa Selbst vs Kevin MacPhee - EPT Berlin’ if you don’t know what I'm talking about.
